definition: Stable project identifier for one interview.
main_limitation: None when manifest is preserved

definition: Public platform identifier for the source video.
main_limitation: Platform identifiers can change or disappear

definition: Source title captured when the sample was prepared.
main_limitation: Titles can be edited by the publisher

definition: Public source URL used to locate the recording.
main_limitation: Availability and licensing can change

definition: Sampling stratum assigned during candidate screening: Studio, Remote, Stage/event, or Panel.
main_limitation: Hybrid productions may cross categories

definition: Predefined source-duration stratum.
main_limitation: None beyond source-duration accuracy

definition: Duration of the prepared source recording.
main_limitation: Edits may remove original context

definition: Number of distinct diarized speaker identifiers.
main_limitation: Diarization can split or merge speakers

definition: Number of consecutive same-speaker segments grouped into turns.
main_limitation: Depends on diarization boundaries

definition: Number of ASR tokens matching the project word-token rule.
main_limitation: ASR may normalize disfluencies

definition: Sum of diarized speech duration across turns.
main_limitation: Exclusive diarization omits overlap

definition: Largest speaker's share of all diarized speech duration.
main_limitation: Speaker splitting or merging changes the share

definition: Sum of squared speaker speech shares; higher values indicate greater concentration.
main_limitation: Not equivalent to social dominance

definition: Mean elapsed duration of grouped speaker turns.
main_limitation: Depends on diarization and grouping rule

definition: Median time from the prior speaker turn ending to the next turn beginning.
main_limitation: Exclusive diarization cannot estimate true overlap

definition: Mean ASR word count per minute of diarized speech across turns.
main_limitation: ASR error and segmentation affect rate

definition: Mean within-turn coefficient of variation in estimated fundamental frequency.
main_limitation: Audio quality and speaker physiology matter

definition: Mean within-turn standard deviation of voiced-frame intensity.
main_limitation: Automatic gain and microphone setup affect intensity

definition: Mean summed gap between consecutive same-speaker segments within a grouped turn.
main_limitation: Segmentation settings change pause counts

definition: Filled pauses and selected discourse fillers per 100 ASR words.
main_limitation: ASR often omits or normalizes fillers

definition: Share of turns flagged as very short, empty, or one-word.
main_limitation: Flags fragility but do not prove error

definition: Number of time-spread frames coded for the interview.
main_limitation: Sparse samples do not represent continuous tracking

definition: Mean visible-person count across sampled frames.
main_limitation: Occlusion and screens-within-screens can confuse counts

definition: Share of sampled frames with zero people visible.
main_limitation: Depends on frame sampling

definition: Share of sampled frames with exactly one person visible.
main_limitation: Depends on editing and camera choice

definition: Share of sampled frames with at least two people visible.
main_limitation: Visible presence is not interaction quality

definition: Share of sampled frames coded as a single-person close-up.
main_limitation: Shot boundaries and codebook definitions can be ambiguous

definition: Share of sampled frames coded as a single-person medium shot.
main_limitation: Shot boundaries and codebook definitions can be ambiguous

definition: Share of sampled frames coded as split screen.
main_limitation: Layout conventions vary by publisher

definition: Share of sampled frames coded as a two-person shot.
main_limitation: Does not imply both people are engaged

definition: Share of sampled frames coded as a wide stage shot.
main_limitation: Format-specific and sparse

definition: Share of sampled frames with an audience visibly present.
main_limitation: Audience may be present but off-camera

definition: Share of sampled frames with slides, charts, screens, or other shared content visible.
main_limitation: Small or partially visible content may be missed

definition: Share of detected person observations coded as looking toward the camera.
main_limitation: Still frames and camera geometry limit inference

definition: Share of detected person observations coded as looking toward another visible person.
main_limitation: Target of gaze may be ambiguous

definition: Share of detected person observations with a visibly raised open, pointing, or other hand position.
main_limitation: Tight crops often hide hands

definition: Share of adjacent sampled-frame pairs whose shot-type codes differ.
main_limitation: Sparse frames do not locate exact edits

definition: Share of adjacent sampled-frame pairs whose first-listed person's gaze code differs.
main_limitation: First-listed person may change across frames

definition: Share of adjacent sampled-frame pairs whose first-listed person's hand-position code differs.
main_limitation: First-listed person may change across frames

definition: Share of sampled frames with at least one model-recorded visibility or coding limitation.
main_limitation: Uncertainty language is model-dependent

definition: Mean number of explicit uncertainty statements per sampled frame.
main_limitation: Counts depend on prompt wording

definition: Order of the sampled frame within its interview.
main_limitation: None when manifest is preserved

definition: Frame timestamp from the start of the prepared recording.
main_limitation: Edits alter correspondence to original broadcast

definition: Whether the timestamp falls inside a diarized speech turn.
main_limitation: Depends on diarization boundaries

definition: Diarized speaker active at the timestamp, or the closest turn when no turn is active.
main_limitation: Does not identify the visible person

definition: Automatic interviewer/guest/other label attached to the active or nearest speaker.
main_limitation: Role assignment showed ambiguity in the pilot

definition: Absolute distance from the frame timestamp to the nearest turn boundary when speech is inactive; zero during speech.
main_limitation: Depends on diarization boundaries

definition: Number of people visibly present in the sampled frame.
main_limitation: Occlusion and composited screens can confuse counts

definition: Structured shot category for the sampled frame.
main_limitation: Some shots sit between codebook categories

definition: Structured context category such as remote, studio, stage, audience, or unknown.
main_limitation: Visual cues can be insufficient

definition: Whether an audience is visibly present in the sampled frame.
main_limitation: Audience may be present off-camera

definition: Whether shared visual content is visible in the sampled frame.
main_limitation: Small inserts can be missed

definition: Whether any detected person is coded as looking toward the camera.
main_limitation: Camera geometry limits certainty

definition: Whether any detected person is coded as looking toward another visible person.
main_limitation: Gaze target can be ambiguous

definition: Whether any detected person has a visibly raised hand.
main_limitation: Hands may be cropped or occluded

definition: Number of explicit visibility or coding limitations recorded for the frame.
main_limitation: Model verbosity affects the count

definition: Sequential grouped-turn number within an interview.
main_limitation: Depends on grouping rule

definition: Anonymous diarized speaker identifier within the recording.
main_limitation: Identifier is local to one recording

definition: Turn start time in HH:MM:SS.mmm.
main_limitation: Diarization timing is approximate

definition: Turn end time in HH:MM:SS.mmm.
main_limitation: Diarization timing is approximate

definition: Time from turn start to turn end.
main_limitation: Includes within-turn gaps

definition: Sum of segment durations inside the grouped turn.
main_limitation: Exclusive diarization omits overlap

definition: Sum of gaps between consecutive same-speaker segments inside the grouped turn.
main_limitation: Depends on segmentation settings

definition: Time from the preceding turn ending to the current turn starting.
main_limitation: Exclusive diarization prevents reliable negative overlap

definition: Count of within-turn segment gaps lasting at least 250 milliseconds.
main_limitation: Segmentation is not word-level pause detection

definition: Count of within-turn segment gaps lasting at least 500 milliseconds.
main_limitation: Segmentation is not word-level pause detection

definition: ASR or aligned-reference word count per minute of diarized speech.
main_limitation: ASR and diarization errors propagate

definition: Median estimated fundamental frequency across voiced frames.
main_limitation: Pitch trackers can octave-error

definition: Standard deviation of fundamental frequency divided by its mean.
main_limitation: Short/noisy turns are fragile

definition: Mean voiced-frame RMS intensity relative to digital full scale.
main_limitation: Not comparable across recording systems without normalization

definition: Standard deviation of voiced-frame intensity.
main_limitation: Compression and noise affect variability

definition: Count of selected filled-pause tokens in the ASR text.
main_limitation: ASR often omits fillers

definition: Count of selected discourse-filler phrases in the ASR text.
main_limitation: Phrase list is incomplete and context-sensitive

definition: Rule-based flag for very short, empty, or one-word turns.
main_limitation: A flag is not proof of error
